newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MARLIN HIKES VOLUMES AFTER BOOKOVER DEAL.
newsitem.headline: MARLIN HIKES VOLUMES AFTER BOOKOVER DEAL.

text.p: Volumes surged in South African granite producing firm Marlin Corp Ltd following a bookover deal worth around 7.5 million rand by stockbroking firm Martindale Stacey du Toit, dealers said.
By about 1105 GMT Marlin was up a cent at 58 cents with just over 12.9 million shares exchanging hands on the counter.
Alan Momberg, a dealer at Martindale Stacey, said the bookover deal had involved 12.9 million shares.
"We did a bookover today and it was just part of normal business," he told Reuters.
